summary: Use bounded composition first: explicit source modes, capacity planning, binary safety/fidelity gates, bounded repair, and atomic publication.
invariants: SlidePlan selects layout family and capacity before authoring.
source-verbatim preserves source text/images/order and fails when same-page fit is impossible.
source-outline is separate and requires explicit user selection for summarization.
Safety/Fidelity are binary; residual failure stays withheld and receipt binds digests before active publication.
forbidden: Do not rely on post-render review as primary composition.
Do not silently summarize verbatim source content.
Do not activate revisions with residual safety or fidelity defects.
